projects.name: The majlis server
projects.description: Set up and maintained a home server on Debian hosting a family photo library, a recipe website, and a network-wide ad blocker, each in its own container managed via a single compose file. Automated full machine rebuilds using playbooks, verified by wiping the disk twice. Built a shell script to check service health every five minutes and send Telegram alerts on failure. Implemented nightly backups to a second disk and weekly offsite backups to a relative's house.

projects.name: Publishing the club website without FTP
projects.description: Migrated the Hail Tech Club website to AWS free tier, serving pages from a storage bucket behind a content delivery network. Set up automatic build and deployment on every merge to the main branch, ensuring broken builds are never published. Wrote a two-page guide for future committees to maintain the site.

experience.title: Infrastructure lead
experience.description: Gave a hands-on workshop, "Your first virtual machine in the cloud," to 35 students. Looks after the club's shared accounts and hands them over each year.
